paragraphs.en: Last spring, Emma, a student from England, visited Samarkand for the first time. She arrived by the fast train from Tashkent. The journey took only two hours, and it was very comfortable.
paragraphs.uz: O'tgan bahorda Angliyalik talaba Emma birinchi marta Samarqandga bordi. U Toshkentdan tezyurar poyezdda keldi. Yo'l atigi ikki soat davom etdi va juda qulay edi.

paragraphs.en: On her first morning, she went to the Registan. She couldn't believe her eyes. The blue tiles were more beautiful than in any photo. She took more than a hundred pictures!
paragraphs.uz: Birinchi kuni ertalab u Registonga bordi. U ko'zlariga ishonolmadi. Moviy koshinlar har qanday suratdagidan ham chiroyliroq edi. U yuzdan ortiq surat oldi!

paragraphs.en: Then she got lost in the old streets. She didn't speak Uzbek or Russian, so she showed a map to a young man. His name was Farrukh. He spoke good English and he walked with her to Siyob Bazaar.
paragraphs.uz: Keyin u eski ko'chalarda adashib qoldi. U o'zbekcha ham, ruscha ham bilmasdi, shuning uchun bir yigitga xaritani ko'rsatdi. Uning ismi Farrux edi. U inglizchani yaxshi gapirardi va u bilan birga Siyob bozorigacha piyoda bordi.

paragraphs.en: At the bazaar, Farrukh helped her to buy some dried apricots and a round Samarkand bread. "This bread is famous," he said. "It stays fresh for a long time." Emma tried it. It was delicious.
paragraphs.uz: Bozorda Farrux unga o'rik qoqi va dumaloq Samarqand nonini sotib olishga yordam berdi. "Bu non mashhur," dedi u. "U uzoq vaqt yangi turadi." Emma tatib ko'rdi. Juda mazali edi.

paragraphs.en: Emma stayed in Samarkand for four days. When she got home, she told her friends, "The buildings were amazing, but the people were even better. I have to go back!"
paragraphs.uz: Emma Samarqandda to'rt kun qoldi. Uyiga qaytgach, do'stlariga: "Binolar ajoyib edi, lekin odamlar bundan ham zo'r edi. Albatta qaytib borishim kerak!" dedi.

questions.q: How did Emma travel from Tashkent?
Why did she show a map to Farrukh?
What is special about Samarkand bread?
options: It stays fresh for a long time.
